author: CNET
description:
The Toniebox 2 is a screen-free audio player for kids. It includes interactive games, fun music and a built-in sunrise alarm clock. The Toniebox 2 is designed for kids ages 1 and up. They can independently turn on or change the music by putting their chosen Tonies character in the designated space at the top of the audio player.
